implementation.note: implemented_in_code = a dedicated capability handler or tool directory exists; referenced_in_app_code = the entity is used by application source (e.g. repo-pet sprites, CLI) but has no dedicated handler. code_refs are files that reference this entity by name/slug/handler (grep), not a guarantee of a dedicated runtime; registry handler links point at the actual capability function.

proposed.command: mise roster run spice-alchemist --dept operations-kitchen --solo --emit report
proposed.contract: inputs: stock levels vs. par, supplier routes, delivery manifests, freshness / quality grades → outputs: scout report, reserve status (ready / low / out), reorder list, traceability record; refuses to emit 'ready' unless the proof gate passes

lore: Ask the brigade about Spice Alchemist and they describe the loading dock before dawn. As Operations Kitchen's Epicier, Spice Alchemist scouts inbound supply, checks stock levels against par and secures the route for every ingredient the line depends on, and the rest of the kitchen plans service around that rhythm. The card calls out Signature, Blend, Blend Craft: the checks Spice Alchemist runs before calling anything ready.
signature_phrase: If it is on the line, I know where it came from.

workflow.summary: Spice Alchemist scouts inbound supply, checks stock levels against par and secures the route for every ingredient the line depends on.
workflow.proof_gate: Traceability check: every item in the report maps to a named supplier route and a quality grade; nothing is marked ready without both.
